basic_profile.bio: An avid gamer and tech enthusiast based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. I work as a software developer in a local IT firm and spend my evenings exploring new video games or watching anime. I enjoy engaging in discussions about technology and gaming, particularly on subreddits like 'ac_newhorizons' and 'Blazblue'. My weekends are often spent with friends exploring local cafes or playing competitive video games. I'm single and usually online during late evenings to early nights, Bangladesh time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Possesses a strong background in software development with a degree in Computer Science from a local university. Has self-taught much of the gaming knowledge by participating in online forums and communities. Regularly engages with tech blogs and gaming news to stay updated on the latest trends.
